data.content_ref: inline:SRC_005 is compatible with SRC_004: both explain the 3-of-26 result as an installation-order artifact, but SRC_005's registry-semantics mechanism (the test constrains only entries installed under a guard the test can detect) is consistent with SRC_004's sequential guard-installation account, and neither requires a generalizable testing condition. Refuted if the same shown-to-fail ritual on a larger, multi-author repository reproduces the 3-of-26 ratio, or if the mutation proposal and guard installation order were randomized and the distribution did not show the observed asymmetry.
